scope: Review of the first archive-recovery implementation before three local corrections

failed_cases: acknowledgement region is not inside a fetch-busy section during held refresh
explicit check cancels an older background read instead of remaining disabled behind it

evidence: Actual component markup plus controlled effect/focus callbacks and real QueryObserver/MutationObserver.
